description: The commands Discord's page may call: notify (a desktop notification), get/set_hotkeys (xray's own bindings), report_events (forward xray's own log events to your log server), sync_config (push/pull your own xray settings blob to your server) and translate (send one message's text to Google's translate endpoint when you pick Translate). Anything granted here can be called by any script on discord.com, Discord's own included, so keep this list small and the commands narrow. notify caps text and drops bursts; set_hotkeys validates every binding, and the page never sees keystrokes, only which xray action fired. report_events and sync_config hold the server address and token on the Rust side and only reach your configured https server, so a hostile script could at most read or overwrite your own xray settings, never anyone else's data.
